source_metadata.purpose: Existing published bounded research distribution rights
Pinned Qwen generator identity and structured output-rights status
Source, model and D20 source-audio restrictions

allowed_input_scope: Only mapped 32 existing synthetic research WAVs, exact original A20 checkpoint, exact source/frontend bytes and metadata.
publication_assessment: Existing public inputs are bounded research distributions. Publishing newly computed features/logits/technical logs is a new derived-output publication and requires the approved bounded public artifact scope; current map grants no publication authorization.
required_output_notices: Preserve Apache-2.0 source/model provenance and BSD-2-Clause frontend notice. Do not blanket relicense third-party assets.
Preserve commercial_output_license=not-established; no commercial clearance or real-person endorsement is established.
D20 are weak historical rehearsal inputs; Qwen12 are exposed reviewed training sources. Neither provides fresh holdout evidence.
Native32 features are newly declared pre-CMVN training-input semantics. Reconstructed D20 official features are compatibility evidence, not a mathematical oracle.
Zero-update original-A20 logits/losses/state hashes are preparation/control evidence only, never a new trained model or acoustic/product/board qualification.
Public outputs must avoid private local paths, provider credentials, secrets, personal metadata and undeclared source/model bytes.
prohibited_scope_expansion: Whole data repository checkout or archive restore
potential_blockers: No required public execution input is missing.
The old original run_baseline.py and training-protocol.json are not exact public files; execution must not require them. Original protocol SHA may be retained as checkpoint identity scalar.
The fixed frozen recipe inventory embeds private workspace provenance. Do not publish it unchanged; use the clean, ordered public mapping and a reviewed consumer contract without private paths.
